$comment: Machine-readable deposit fee schedule (Phase 22 play 6, FEE_SCHEDULE_PATH).
This file does not invent pricing. Every amount below is transcribed from the '## Rates and
Fees' table of the product sheet named in `rule_basis`, which lives in the knowledge corpus and
is the citable source a fee-recovery finding points at. The corpus stays the single source of
truth for humans; this file is the same rules in a form the detector can evaluate.
All money is integer cents, per design 1.1 - a fee is never a float.
Waiver keys, any one of which waives the cycle's maintenance fee:
min_balance_cents              - the account's own balance at or above this
min_monthly_credit_cents       - a qualifying recurring credit posted in the cycle
min_relationship_balance_cents - the customer's deposits plus investments at or above this,
Products with no maintenance fee (CD-12M, CD-36M) are deliberately absent: absence means
'nothing is billable here', so the detector raises no finding against them.
The courtesy-waiver allowance the FEE_WAIVED detector uses is NOT stated numerically by any
corpus document - pol-fee-waiver-authority only requires supervisor review of repeated waivers.
It is therefore a configured threshold (FEE_RECOVERY_COURTESY_WAIVER_CYCLES), not a rule read
from the corpus, and the finding says so.
